policy.noEndorsement: Listing is not endorsement. Records exist so a reader can find something and judge it, not because we vouch for it.
policy.evidenceRule: Availability is recorded from a reachable source. Where no reachable source established a state, the record says unknown rather than guessing.
policy.networkFailureRule: A network failure is not evidence that a product closed. It produces unreachable, never deprecated or closed.
policy.conflictRule: Conflicting evidence produces unverified, never a guess.

availabilityStates.verified-active: A reachable source established that it is operating.
availabilityStates.degraded: Reachable, but a reachable source established that it is not fully operating.
availabilityStates.unreachable: Could not be reached at the last check. This is not evidence of closure.
availabilityStates.deprecated: A reachable source from the operator established that it is being retired.
availabilityStates.closed: A reachable source from the operator established that it has shut down.
availabilityStates.unknown: No reachable source established any state.

custodyModels.custodial: A third party holds the keys.
custodyModels.non-custodial-service: A service that never holds keys but does hold other user data.
custodyModels.not-applicable: The record is not a wallet or a service that holds anything.

records.name: Atomicals ElectrumX
records.evidence: Source repository read at commit 8df23747835c20230fc8b8097d469e7a1d97c3e0, released as v1.5.2.0 on 2025-03-27, and used as the pinned reference baseline throughout this documentation.
records.securityNotes: This is the protocol authority. Pin a revision and record the network. Two revisions can interpret the same transaction differently.

records.name: Atomicals JavaScript CLI
records.evidence: Source read at commit 1333565efbfe5ca4bdb8443a94d72e9f8534c2c4. The complete command inventory on this site is generated from lib/cli.ts at that revision.
records.securityNotes: Manages local wallet files. Build commands spend outputs. Model any transfer before running it.

records.name: Atomicals protocol guide
records.evidence: Repository reachable and used as a documented source. The guide itself states that the specification is defined in code.
records.securityNotes: Explanatory material. Version sensitive behavior is decided by the validator, not by the guide.

records.name: Atomicals Improvement Proposals
records.evidence: Repository cloned at commit be08d7856db7c55c2bfb7c2c08f88a25f1c781f8. It contains AIP-1 and AIP-3, both with status Draft.
records.securityNotes: A proposal existing is not evidence that anything implements it. See the AIP registry.

records.name: Atomicals Virtual Machine interpreter
records.evidence: Source read at commit c185e6216a3ea2cb2e011e508033ca535ece3472. The opcode inventory on this site is generated from src/script/script.h at that revision.
records.securityNotes: Beta. Not deployed by Universe on any network. Re-enabled opcodes and arbitrary precision arithmetic make host resource limits mandatory.

records.name: AVM white paper
records.evidence: Referenced by the interpreter README. No independent reachability check was performed for this record.
records.securityNotes: Architectural concepts only. Nothing described in it is implemented by virtue of being described.

records.name: Universe ARC-20 index and Marketplace v1 authority
records.evidence: Source read at commit 670030e500710aaef77410540768a87a138d8134. Declared coverage is partial, with the reason recorded on the ARC-20 API page.
records.securityNotes: Every marketplace action gate defaults to off. No public origin is published in this documentation.

records.name: Universe Atomicals NFT and Realm index
records.evidence: Source read at commit 1d9109c68d95d5985632a60d6596b3612d3f6ef1. Its own provenance manifest declares the included and excluded asset kinds.
records.securityNotes: Read only, no write capabilities. Fungible tokens, Containers, and DMINT items are excluded from the projection by declaration.

records.name: Ordex marketplace contract
records.evidence: Repository read at commit 2f7d8d3ec59fac534f545bf03ed0d41878f91a0e, carrying an OpenAPI document, conformance vectors, an SDK, and a purchase verifier.
records.securityNotes: Use the published contract and verifier rather than reimplementing purchase validation.

records.name: Bitcoin Inscribe
records.evidence: Consumes this documentation as the frontend/docs/arc-20-docs submodule, verified through its own submodule pin contract.
records.securityNotes: A product surface. What it exposes is Universe implementation, not protocol behavior.

records.name: Third-party Atomicals marketplaces and explorers
records.evidence: No reachable source was checked for any third-party marketplace or explorer during this review. Listing one from an older directory without checking it would assert a state we did not establish.
records.securityNotes: A listing on any marketplace is not evidence of ownership. Ownership is verified at settlement, against the chain.
